title: The Masked Judge
text: A judge in a blank white mask holds court in the street from a chair of stacked doors, before a crowd that does not breathe. You are accused, he says, though no one will say of what. The gallows behind him is already strung.

options.label: The smoothest tongue pleads your case, charge or no charge.

outcomes.text: You are acquitted. The breathless crowd cheers without a sound.
Guilty. The fine is heavy, and the gallows creaks in disappointment.

options.label: Confess to whatever he likes, and pay the fine before the rope.

outcomes.text: The fine is small, but the mask stares at you a long while. You feel you have confessed to something true.

options.label: Tear the mask from the judge to see who sits in judgement.

outcomes.text: Under the mask is another mask. The whole court rises at once.
